I wish I could leave a picture because this business really charged me full price on a simple headliner job where the headliner was already out of the car and prepped, ready to go for new basic fabric and still... they charged full price that would normally include installation and removal at around $250, and it wasn't even worth it. Marks were left on the new fabric and they didn't even do the sunroof either so I am left with the biggest waste of time AND money I've ever had the displeasure of experiencing. Oh yeah they only take cash or check which normally isn't an issue but when the boss mans english isnt so good they forget to clarify that they mean 'No, cash or check only' and not "no cash or check" leaving you to race through rush hour traffic to get the cash from an atm at the last minute and then race back to the shop before they close at 6pm. I really have half a mind not to take it back there and have them install the headliner and sunroof themselves but they really left me feeling so dissatisfied that I do not want to ever touch or deal with this business in the future.
